summary: RSS-Bridge is a self-hosted tool that generates standard RSS and Atom feeds for websites that do not natively provide them. It acts as a translation layer, scraping target sites to output syndication formats that your regular feed reader can consume. This allows you to centralise updates from platforms that lack subscription options.
goodFor: Anyone who relies on a central feed reader and wants to follow websites, forums, or social platforms that only display content on their own pages.
watchOut: Target websites frequently update their layouts, which can break individual bridges and require constant maintenance or community updates to keep working.
deployNotes: As a PHP application available via Docker, it typically requires a persistent volume if you modify default configurations, and sits behind a standard reverse proxy handling TLS.
